description: Defines the monitor_stats class for managing and collecting network monitoring statistics, including AP metrics, station traffic, and radio metrics, within the prplMesh project.

classes.name: monitor_stats
classes.description: Class responsible for collecting, processing, and sending network monitoring statistics such as AP metrics, station traffic, and radio metrics.

methods.name: monitor_stats
methods.description: Constructor initializing monitor_stats with a reference to a CmduMessageTx object.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts monitoring with provided database and client.

methods.name: add_request
methods.description: Adds a measurement request with specified ID, sync flag, and optional MAC address.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Processes collected data, optionally handling instantly.

methods.name: add_ap_metrics
methods.description: Collects and adds AP metrics to a message.

methods.name: add_ap_assoc_sta_link_metric
methods.description: Adds link metrics for associated stations.

methods.name: set_byte_counter_units
methods.description: Sets the units for byte counters (Bytes, KiB, MiB).

methods.name: calculate_client_load
methods.description: Calculates client load based on station and radio nodes.

methods.name: recalculate_byte_units
methods.description: Recalculates byte values to support R2 specification units.

methods.name: send_associated_sta_link_metrics
methods.description: Sends link metrics for associated stations.
